description: This file defines a utility function 'shapeAgentGroupedSeries' that processes raw aggregated records related to cost data, transforming and grouping them into a format suitable for visualization with Recharts. It handles categorization, sorting, and zero-filling for missing categories across agents.

methods.name: shapeAgentGroupedSeries(records, groupBy = "environment", options)
methods.description: Transforms raw cost aggregation records into a grouped dataset suitable for charting, with optional sorting and category handling.
